title: 優先度の並びを逆にする
rule: 着手する順は、優先度の高いものが先

title: メモを書いた人を記録しなくなる
rule: ユーザーが書いたメモには by: user が付く

edits.find: const added = note?.trim() ? { at, text: note.trim(), by: "ai" as const } : null;
edits.replace: const added = note?.trim() ? { at, text: "", by: "ai" as const } : null;

title: 数値を返す関数が文字列を返す

edits.find: const number = Number(db.prepare("SELECT coalesce(max(number), 0) + 1 AS next FROM lessons").get()?.next);
edits.replace: const number: number = String(db.prepare("SELECT coalesce(max(number), 0) + 1 AS next FROM lessons").get()?.next);
